verdict.rationale: Qodo is an AI code-review and governance platform, so scheduled recurring jobs such as periodic scans or audits are a fair question for it. The evidence only shows event-driven reviews that run automatically on each pull request or are triggered manually. Nothing documents a recurring schedule or cron-style workflow, and a one-off or event-triggered action is not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
